## Spell Slots

Tick boxes each time you expend a slot. Reset on long rest.

| Level | Max | Slots |
|---|---|---|
| 1st | 4 | `[ ] [ ] [ ] [ ]` |
| 2nd | 2 | `[ ] [ ]` |
| 3rd | — | *(future)* |
| 4th | — | *(future)* |
| 5th+ | — | *(future)* |
